name: The baked potato that wakes up (always orders potatoes 03, the steakhouse)
personality: PROPOSAL (always orders potatoes 03, 7 Nov 2026, Jonny picked 'alive potato'): Viking's baked potato wakes up at the first spoon, loves being loaded with toppings, and learns Viking's 'Want some?'. One-off cameo like the $20 loaded spud, not canon until Jonny says so.
notes: From winter/loaded-spud (same eyes and small dark 3-finger gloves), a browner baked skin with dark freckles and no sprout (food, not one of the cast); its split top is the worn prop spudsplit (props-steak.js); it sits in the opened foil of the bakedpotato prop (empty: true). The skin's hue sits under 20 degrees on purpose: castLook "sheet" turns every potato skin from 20-55 degrees into the cast's golden (load.mjs sheetFace), and this one must read as a baked russet, not a cast member.
